commits.message:
feat(core): add getSelectedText() API

Implements Roadmap P0 #5 - getSelectedText() method for EditorAPI.

Changes:
- Add getSelectedText() method signature to EditorAPI interface
- Implement method using view.state.sliceDoc() with selection range
- Add 6 comprehensive test cases covering:
  - Empty selection
  - Single-line selection
  - Multi-line selection
  - Markdown formatting preservation
  - Destroyed editor state
  - Reversed selection (head before anchor)

The method returns the currently selected text as a string, handling
all edge cases including empty selections and reversed ranges. Returns
empty string when editor is destroyed.

All 220 tests pass without regressions.
